'''Ussuis''' was the second<ref name="TT" /><ref name="FS" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Centares (star)|Centares]] in the [[Centares system/Legends|Centares system]],<ref name="TT" /> located in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ussuis had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="TT" /> and was covered by a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="TT" /><ref name="FS" /> The first planet of the system, [[Filo]], and Ussuis were separated from the rest of the system by an [[Liotch|asteroid belt]].<ref name="FS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ussuis was first introduced in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="TT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Centares system, and therefore Ussuis, in grid square R-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
